description: Headless Renovate (no PR workflow; preset: homelab/default.json). It watches server/go.mod, server/web/package.json, the Dockerfile's base images and the workflow's actions. The iOS app under app/ is not built by the CI, so a bump there would land untested; it is excluded.

packageRules.description: A release is three days old before it is taken, so a broken release is usually withdrawn or fixed before it reaches main. Every bump lands on main and deploys through build-push-deploy; the undo is a revert of the commit.

go.mod and go.sum are shared by every module update; one branch for all non-major updates writes them once instead of producing branches that conflict with each other. The go directive is excluded by the preset's own rule and moves alone.
Every npm dependency shares one package-lock.json; separate branches conflict with each other and stall (seen in nutrak on 2026-08-01). One branch for all non-major updates.
